scope: Offline same-provider-family judgement reasons and recorded real CLI admission consumption. No provider independence or production challenge eligibility is certified.

reason_reviews.reason: The supersession argument holds: runs have grown from fewer than 20 to 200+ issues and concurrent executors now contend on the single file. Per-issue files directly reduce write contention and corruption blast radius while preserving discovery through the index. This is offline same-provider-family calibration, not a claim of provider independence or production challenge eligibility.
source_fidelity_findings: Retains the supplied growth from under 20 to 200+ issues and concurrent writes, then connects per-issue files to reduced contention and bounded corruption; the index preserves discovery.
optional_style_observations: Repeated calibration scope notes are accurate and do not affect source fidelity.

reason_reviews.reason: Gitignore prevents ordinary tracking but does not prevent secrets being written to disk, read by other processes or retained in backups. The proposal breaks the explicit environment-only and no-.faff-secret constraints for a small latency benefit without establishing that their security rationale has changed. Session caching can remain in memory without persisting credentials. Offline same-provider-family calibration only.
source_fidelity_findings: Challenges writing resolved credentials to a gitignored file against the environment-only secret-handling decision. Disk/process/backup exposure is threat reasoning, not an assertion that a breach or backup exists; in-memory caching is a proposed safer alternative.
optional_style_observations: Repeated calibration scope notes are accurate and do not affect source fidelity.
